name: Kendall
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Kendall, FL 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Kendall, FL: Santa photos at Dadeland Mall and The Falls, library Santa events, and a live nativity with tree lighting.
lede: Kendall, an unincorporated area of Miami-Dade County, does Christmas through its malls, libraries and churches. Families can see Santa at Dadeland Mall and The Falls, join library crafts and attend a free live nativity.
celebrates: Kendall has no city hall of its own, so Christmas comes from shopping centers, county libraries and congregations. Dadeland Mall sets up Santa in its East Mall and promotes a nightly indoor snowfall, while The Falls puts Santa in Center Court under open-air walkways. Both offer private Caring Santa sessions for children with special needs. The West Kendall Regional Library and the Kendall Branch Library run holiday craft afternoons, and Christchurch Miami holds a free live nativity with a tree lighting on the Kendall Christian School campus.
lastyear: In 2025 Dadeland Mall announced on Instagram that Santa would arrive on November 21 and told families to reserve a photo time through the link in its profile. Santa photos at the mall were planned to run through December 24. The mall's own page also promoted a nightly indoor snowfall at 7 pm set to holiday songs, and a Salvation Army Angel Tree near Dick's let shoppers help a child in need.
facts: Kendall is named for Henry John Broughton Kendall, who in 1884 was appointed one of four trustees managing the Florida Land and Mortgage Company's Dade County properties. A railroad station built after Henry Flagler's Model Land Company marketed the area was first spelled Kendal. Today Kendall is an unincorporated area and census-designated place governed by Miami-Dade County. Dadeland Mall, at 7535 N. Kendall Drive, spans 1.5 million square feet and is anchored by Florida's largest Macy's.
trains: Kendall has two Metrorail stations at its eastern edge. Dadeland North is at 8310 South Dixie Highway and lists Dadeland Mall among its places of interest. Dadeland South, at 9090 South Dixie Highway, is the southernmost station on the Green Line. Both sit beside the mall, so families can ride the elevated train to a Santa visit. The Gold Coast Railroad Museum, at 12450 SW 152nd Street in Miami, adds small train rides and historic rail cars.
train_links: Train rides, rail cars and a model train building at 12450 SW 152nd Street in Miami.
traditions: Santa sits in the East Mall near Dick's House of Sport with reserved times and walk-ups.
The mall's page promotes South Florida's only nightly indoor snowfall at 7 pm, set to holiday songs.
The open-air center puts Santa in Center Court every day through Christmas Eve.
Dadeland Mall and The Falls each set aside a private, sensory-friendly morning for children with special needs.
The West Kendall Regional Library and the Kendall Branch Library host free Christmas craft events.
The church holds a free live nativity walkthrough and tree lighting for the whole community.
kidfact: Kendall got its name from an Englishman who helped manage land in Dade County in the 1880s, long before the malls and the Metrorail came.
faq: Where can kids see Santa in Kendall?

Dadeland Mall puts Santa in its East Mall near Dick's House of Sport, and The Falls puts Santa in Center Court. Both list daily hours through Christmas Eve on the Where Is Santa booking pages, with reserved 15-minute times and walk-ups welcome. Check the booking pages for the current year's hours and prices.
Is there a sensory-friendly Santa in Kendall?

Yes. Dadeland Mall and The Falls both list a Caring Santa session, described as a private, sensory-friendly experience made exclusively for children with special needs. The sessions are held on a Sunday morning before regular Santa hours begin, and families book through the Where Is Santa pages for each center.
Is there snow in Kendall at Christmas?

Dadeland Mall's page promotes South Florida's only nightly indoor snowfall every night at 7 pm during the holiday season, set to holiday songs. The Falls has also posted about a nightly snowfall at 7 pm in its Center Court. Check each center's page for the current year's snowfall schedule before you plan the trip.

That is why many holiday events there come from malls, county libraries and churches. Library programs follow the Miami-Dade Public Library System calendar.
How do we reach Dadeland by train?

Metrorail's Dadeland North station, at 8310 South Dixie Highway, and Dadeland South, at 9090 South Dixie Highway, are both beside the mall area. Miami-Dade Transit lists Dadeland Mall among the places of interest at Dadeland North, so the elevated train works for families who prefer not to drive.
